purpose: Visual proposals only; no application implementation
base: Create a high-fidelity UX/UI redesign contact sheet for Kratai Thai running platform, matching the attached APPROVED visual reference. Playful Modern, STRICT slate #34495F + mint #9BE8C7 + white/pale mint. Preserve reference rabbit mascot identity (white rabbit, pink ears, slate/mint sportswear); use small purposeful mascot only, no giant mascot on forms. Consistent header brand 'กระต่าย Kratai', navigation, spacious rounded cards, strong readable Thai typography, slate buttons with white text, mint selected states. Clean flat screenshot artwork, no devices, no perspective. Show FOUR DISTINCT COMPLETE PAGE MOCKUPS in a 2x2 grid, each with an outside numbered Thai page title, ample gutters, large landscape high-resolution image. Each screen has readable content and genuinely distinct layout reflecting purpose, not duplicate homepages. Use fictional demo data only and label 'ข้อมูลตัวอย่าง'. For payment or social login show 'Sandbox' clearly. Events use future 2569/2570 sample dates. No admin or organizer dashboard. This is visual concept, not live website. Reference styling is binding; retain brand cohesiveness.

boards.prompt: Screens: 01 ค้นหางานวิ่ง: homepage hero 'ก้าวต่อไป ไปด้วยกัน', running rabbit, keyword/province/month search and scenic mint event cards with net prices. 02 ปฏิทินงานวิ่ง: month calendar with event markers, month navigation and distance/province filters, selected day event list on right. 03 รายละเอียดงานวิ่ง: scenic Chiang Mai event cover, date/location, tabs about/distances/race pack/schedule/rules, sticky right price/register summary. 04 ผลการแข่งขันและอัลบั้ม: same event context, results and photo-album links, clear empty state when organizer has not published results; no invented finish statistics.

Screens: 05 เข้าสู่ระบบ: email/password form, remember option, forgot password link, social Google Facebook LINE buttons explicitly Sandbox, friendly small mascot. 06 สมัครสมาชิก ขั้น 1: account creation email/password/confirm-password and consent, social Sandbox option, next button. 07 สมัครสมาชิก ขั้น 2: runner profile basics Thai/English name, birth date, gender, phone, nationality, document type, clear 2-column fields, submit. 08 ลืมรหัสผ่าน: email input and send-reset-link button, safe generic confirmation panel and Sandbox notice, return to login. Each is a real complete auth screen, not all variants in one panel.

Screens: 13 สมัครวิ่ง ที่อยู่: choose pickup at event or delivery, saved address picker, recipient/phone/address fields, delivery fee, separate event rules acceptance from optional marketing consent. 14 สมัครวิ่ง ชำระเงิน: itemized entry fee, platform fee, optional merchandise, delivery, total THB, PromptPay/card choices labelled Sandbox, confirm button and duplicate-submit protection visual. 15 สมัครวิ่ง สำเร็จ: restrained cheering original rabbit, confirmation reference, runner name sample, event/distance, QR card explicitly sample, payment status and next steps collect BIB, button view my entries. 16 บัตรวิ่งและคำสั่งซื้อของฉัน: separate tabs race entries and merchandise orders, upcoming entries with payment states and QR details, orders with delivery status; no mixing race entitlement with product purchase.

Screens: 17 ร้านค้าประจำงาน: event context, merchandise grid of shirts/medals, sizes/prices/availability, text 'ซื้อสินค้าได้โดยไม่สมัครวิ่ง'. 18 เลือกสินค้าและการรับสินค้า: selected shirt detail with image/size/quantity, pickup or delivery and address, basket summary, no race registration fields. 19 สรุปและชำระค่าสินค้า: itemized merchandise checkout, Sandbox payment selection, confirmation/receipt area, no race entitlement, clear order and delivery status. 20 ความปลอดภัยบัญชี: contact email, change password with verify-code step access, linked accounts, active sessions, action revoke other devices; discreet small mascot, sober clear destructive actions, no giant hero.

Screens: 21 ข้อมูลส่วนตัว: account profile shell with slim left menu, avatar, Thai/English name, birthdate, gender, nationality, phone, document, completion progress, save. 22 ผู้ติดต่อฉุกเฉิน: SAME account shell, multiple contacts with name relationship phone, primary indicator, add/edit form panel. 23 ที่อยู่จัดส่ง: SAME shell, saved addresses with default label and add/edit form. 24 ผู้สมัครที่บันทึกไว้: SAME shell, saved family/team participant profiles, add/edit participant and select primary, clear fictional data.
